review.notes: Checked against full judgment, no changes. Petitioner pressed 4 of 11 SCN grounds (2.2-2.4, 2.8); only 2.8 (180-day sundry-creditor payment) maps to a schema defect type (reply_not_considered) and the court expressly found it was considered (para 9, defect_rejected). Grounds 2.2-2.4 are a merits/jurisdictional-error argument about ITC eligibility, not a procedural defect in our taxonomy, and the court declined to examine them under Art.226 (paras 10-11) rather than ruling on a defect type -- correctly left out of defects_argued. Outcome 'disposed'/not remanded is correct: the order was not set aside, only liberty given to raise other un-pleaded grounds in a future appeal. Note: counsel's submission at para 4 cites the order date as '4th February, 2025', conflicting with para 1's '29th January, 2025' used throughout the rest of the judgment and the operative order -- kept 29.01.2025 as the authoritative date (judgment's own internal inconsistency, not a model error).
